source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), the Librarian’s unit can make a D6 psychic roll while it is free of **battle-shock**. On a 1 the unit becomes **battle-shocked**. Give its ranged attacks +6″ **R**.
